refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Udev is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# An interface for controlling systemd-udevd. interface io.systemd.Udev
# Enable/disable trace logging. method SetTrace( # Enable/disable. enable: bool ) -> ()
# Sets the maximum number of child processes. method SetChildrenMax( # The maximum number of child processes. When 0 is specified, the maximum is determined based on the system resources. number: int ) -> ()
# Sets the global udev properties. method SetEnvironment( # An array of global udev property assignments. Each string must be in KEY=VALUE style. assignments: []string ) -> ()
# Revert previously set configurations. method Revert() -> ()
# Starts processing of queued events. method StartExecQueue() -> ()
# Stops processing of queued events. method StopExecQueue() -> ()
# Terminates systemd-udevd. This exists for backward compatibility. Please consider to use 'systemctl stop systemd-udevd.service'. method Exit() -> ()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Udev shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Udev.SetTrace '{}' invokes its SetTrace() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Udev interface was added in version 258.
Exit(), Revert(), SetChildrenMax(), SetEnvironment(), SetTrace(), StartExecQueue(), and StopExecQueue() were added in version 258.
